mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies pass on higher costs to consumers.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the labor tightening signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% over 3 months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the strong demand signal, or the correlation between RSAFS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over 2 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the contraction signal, or the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low CPIAUCSL (below 2%) indicates subdued inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL is below 2%, or the correlation between low CPIAUCSL and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings increase.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the strong labor market signal, or the joint correlation between PAYEMS increases, UNRATE decreases, and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a rise in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% during a period of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4%) signals robust economic demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low unemployment with strong housing demand
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the strong demand signal, or the joint correlation between HOUST increases, low UNRATE, and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of decreasing industrial production (INDPRO) and increasing retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a shift from manufacturing to services, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate a shift in economic structure.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1% and RSAFS increases > 2% in 3 months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the structural shift signal, or the joint correlation between INDPRO decreases, RSAFS increases, and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
